## Evidence and data changes

- [ ] I linked the primary source or DOI for each new claim.
- [ ] The food identity and tissue or plant part match the source.
- [ ] The sample is raw and uncooked; raw-form details (such as dry grain/legume, maturity, skin, milling, or moisture state) are explicit.
- [ ] Detected, predicted, measured, and derived information are labeled accurately.
- [ ] Reported values, units, ranges, sample context, and conversions are retained where available.
- [ ] Relevant reliable source families were searched, and the food dossier records coverage, conflicts, exclusions, and remaining gaps.
- [ ] Any food image is a real photograph of the correct species and form, with source, license, visual match, and required visible attribution recorded.
- [ ] Free sugars and bound polymer residues are distinguished; cooked/processed amounts were not transferred to a raw profile.
- [ ] I checked that the source license permits this contribution and recorded its terms.
- [ ] I followed `data/evidence-record.schema.json` for accepted food records.
